Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: Fixed: Apply is now correctly disabled while you're in a duty or sitting in the Duty Finder queue - it used to stay green and would drop your queue if used. Fixed: applying a preset now works even if you last left the Party Finder on the World or Private tab; it switches back to Data Centre first instead of half-applying. New presets now have Auto-Adjust Roles (Seek Job Distributions) enabled by default; existing presets are unchanged.
